notes.title: Who Is Your Favorite Character? Vote here and check out the NFTs
notes.content:
Over a OpenSea there are 82 unique pieces of digital art, minted as unique NFTs.  Go over there and like the characters you most enjoyed in the game and get your official NFT of your favorites.

There is 1 NFT for each in game unique character bust.  so, mostly one per character but for Indie there are 23 (one for each beard, etc.)

https://opensea.io/collection/who-stole-my-beard

Don't know what NFTs are? Read this: https://www.theverge.com/22310188/nft-explainer-what-is-blockchain-crypto-art-faq
